title: WardenClyffe plugin manifest (v1)
description: The master contract every plugin.json validates against. cortex-control is the master control-layer plugin; Clyffy-Dean minions DERIVE from it and must satisfy this same shape. Secrets are REFERENCES only — values never live in a package (they materialize at /run/shippin-secrets on the devstation). See plugins/README.md and docs/specs/CORTEX_CONTROL_LAYER_SPEC.md.

slug.description: kebab-case package id; matches the plugins/<slug>/ directory name.

kind.description: control = orchestration/law/capture; intelligence = retrieval (Qdrant/Surreal); minion = Dean-derived specialist.

version.description: SemVer. Bumped by .pulse packets; minions track the master's minor.

mcp_id.description: Context Mesh grammar: mcp.<scope>.<path...>. e.g. mcp.workspace.clyffy-master.cortex

command.description: Executable name; one shared binary may serve many plugins (cortex-mcp does).

transports.description: Supported MCP transports. stdio today; streamable-http added at the ADR 0030 bar (OAuth 2.1, server card) to reach status formal-mcp.

items.description: Infisical secret REF (UPPER_SNAKE env name) — never a value.

secrets.description: Secret references only. Values materialize at /run/shippin-secrets on the devstation.

network.description: Human-readable egress targets the plugin needs, e.g. '10.0.0.106:6333 (Qdrant)'.
